title: Plain & Precious
description: Improves certain parts of existing textures while still keeping it true to Vanilla Minecraft!
body:
![full logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/44d9fb6f2b4bccb3a93bd495501cc424f88a9983.png)

A resource pack that improves certain aspects of Vanilla Minecraft, while staying true to its **Plain & Precious!**

This pack contains many additions like **new item and block textures, fluid animations, even neat quality of life improvements & much, much more!**
